rules.title: Complete D01 through D22 coverage
rules.requirement: Exactly one selected candidate or promoted artifact must exist for every doctrine identifier D01 through D22.

rules.title: Exact source identity
rules.requirement: The source path must resolve and the recorded source SHA-256 must equal the physical source hash.

rules.title: Candidate identity and lifecycle
rules.requirement: Candidate identity, version, status, classification, authority holder, and non-promoting effect must be explicit.

rules.title: Executable doctrine contract
rules.requirement: The doctrine must define purpose, scope, governing rules, inputs or prerequisites, outputs or receipts, runtime interfaces or procedures, failure behavior, mechanical tests, cross-doctrine boundaries, and candidate status.

rules.title: No description-only obligations
rules.requirement: Every material obligation must identify an actor or runtime, trigger, required behavior, evidence, and failure disposition, or reference a controlling contract that does.

rules.title: No independent authority creation
rules.requirement: Models, reviewers, pollers, workflows, repositories, databases, votes, and insertions must not create promotion, access, disclosure, deployment, or exception authority.

rules.title: Promotion boundary
rules.requirement: D05 controls promotion and rollback authority; D22 controls canonical reconciliation and distribution.

rules.title: Deterministic doctrine routing
rules.requirement: Doctrine selection must derive from versioned triggers, task and artifact metadata, authority, lane, lifecycle, and admitted capability rather than model intuition alone.

rules.title: Affected-action isolation
rules.requirement: Missing sources, tools, adapters, or capabilities must isolate dependent actions while unrelated safe work continues unless a reserved broader condition applies.

rules.title: Operational state accuracy
rules.requirement: Created, inserted, queued, dispatched, delivered, acknowledged, tested, verified, promoted, deployed, operating, and reconciled states must not be conflated.

rules.title: Material claim evidence
rules.requirement: Material factual, quantitative, security, readiness, delivery, commercial, or status claims must identify evidence, scope, environment, date, and known limitations.

rules.title: Invalid-test detection
rules.requirement: A test that fails before exercising the intended control must be classified INVALID_TEST and cannot support PASS.

rules.title: Security and privacy at creation
rules.requirement: Secrets, access, authorization, privacy, retention, protected data, negative tests, and exposure response must be governed at object or artifact creation.

rules.title: Applicable accessibility requirements
rules.requirement: Applicable structural, interaction, visual, audio, cognitive, error, recovery, and alternative-format requirements must be declared and tested.

rules.title: Rollback or forward recovery
rules.requirement: Material change must define and, where required, test rollback, restoration, compensation, or forward recovery.

rules.title: No competing control ownership
rules.requirement: Overlapping doctrines must identify one controlling owner and explicit specialization boundaries rather than duplicate authority, promotion, routing, data, or distribution services.

rules.title: Unique mechanical tests
rules.requirement: Every doctrine must contain unique scenario-based mechanical tests with observable required results.

rules.title: No fixed local authority paths
rules.requirement: Doctrine must not depend on file URLs, fixed Windows paths, named devices, or provider-specific behavior as universal authority.

rules.title: DART final assurance
rules.requirement: Final assurance must complete Define, Assess, Resolve, and Test and return an objective disposition.
